svg.aria-label: Every layer expanded: how each unit is built, and what can act on readiness directly
svg.text: Every layer expanded: how each unit is built, and what can act on readiness directly
Data flows up: sources → metrics → units → score pillars → readiness. Layer names are working names.

g.text: layer 1 · weighted mean of the score pillars
Red flags: units that act on readiness directly
Illness check (temperature, breathing, resting HR, HRV):
live today, takes 10 or 25 points off readiness
Proposed caps: fever 40 · illness 60 · HRV crash 60 ·

svg.text: Source pills: filled = sends it today · dashed = planned (Oura API) or possible (Strap worn overnight, HC = Health Connect, built but unused).
Red edge and red line = a unit that can act on readiness directly, on top of its share inside its score pillar. Dashed box = not built.
Health and Nutrition are possible score pillars; today their units sit inside Body. Latency also reads raw heart rate at sleep onset.
Working names, numbered top to bottom: 1 readiness · 2 score pillar · 3 unit · 4 metric · 5 source.
